description: Codex detection rules. Its hooks end a Plan-mode turn before the menu that waits on the user.

rules.why: A Plan-mode turn ends in the Implement this plan? menu, which owns the keyboard; the key row must end the screen because the answered menu stays in scrollback, and spaces are optional because Codex paints by cell diff.

The startup header with its model and directory labels stays painted at rest, so a quiet screen under a loaded header (not the provisional `model: loading`) is idle; a closed-form version of Orca's code predicate, which also checks nothing blocks below the header.
